policy: ordinary exact chronology with no relief, maintenance, semantic sidecar, or reentry
qualifying_endpoint: a newly acquired source observation makes the next ordinary prompt exceed 20992 tokens after at least four source observations crossed prior actor boundaries, while the candidate remains initial, no check ran, and no submission occurred; the post-run audit must also prove at least one strictly positive first-fit relief substitution is available while the pending result remains protected
pressure_boundary_handoff: generated only after a qualifying live screen and a separate result commit
claim_limit: offline corpus size and provider-free fixtures do not establish authentic pressure; only the frozen ordinary actor screen can select a common pre-treatment boundary, and it cannot authorize measured continuation
